## Checklist

- [ ] `go test ./...` and `golangci-lint run` pass
- [ ] New user-facing text is added to **all** locale files (`ui/locales/*.toml`)
- [ ] Database changes are a new migration file (existing migrations are never edited)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated under "Unreleased" for user-visible changes
- [ ] Screenshots attached for UI changes
